tei:div.tei:p: "$ (87)༄༅// rab tu spros med kyi dbang chog 'od kyi dra ba bzhugs so/// /

(88)dgongs pa brda dang snyan brgyud la// gus pas btud de phyag 'tshal nas// rab tu spros pa med pa yi// dbang bskur cho ga bshad par bya// de la rab tu dben pa'i gnas su rin po che dang*/ 'bru dang*/ sman dang*/ dri dang*/ spos kyi maṇ+ḍal tshan pa lnga gral thabs su bkod pa'i mthar/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang tshogs kyis nye bar mdzes par bya'o// shin tu spros med dang dus mnyam du byed na/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang gcig las logs su bsham mi dgos la/ gzhan du dgos so// 'di dag ras dkar dri ma med pa'i steng du/ dar tshon kha dog mi gcig pa lnga bting ba la skud ris sam/ re khās zlum skor lnga tshan lnga pa byas pa'i dbus mthing kha la rin po che/ de'i g.yas kyi dkar po la me tog /de'i rtsar ser po la 'bru/ g.yon gyi dmar po la sman/ de'i rtsar ljang gu la dri dang spos rnams bkram par bya ba ni phyag len du mdzad pa'o// de nas slob ma rnams grwi dang sman spos kyis khrus byas la/ bla mas shar du gzigs pa la phyag 'tshal te/ (89)kha nub tu phyogs pas 'jig rten thams cad rin po che la sogs pas gang bar dmigs te/ maṇ+ḍal lnga tshan rnams rim gyis phul bas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub la spyod cing*/ khyad par du rin po che'i yon tan gyis chos zad mi shes pa la spyod/ dris chos nyid dag pa'i gsung dbyangs la spyod/ sman gyis sdug bsngal thams cad las grol ba'i bde ba la spyod/ spos kyis ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyi ro la spyod/ 'bras bus 'byor pa mtha' yas pa la spyod pa'o// zhes phan yon kyang bshad do// de nas dbang dngos la bzhi ste/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i rim pa/ zhugs pa'i dbang*/ dbang las thob pa'i ngo sprod/ dbugs dbyung zhing dga' ston bya ba'i rim pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ dris lan gyis rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bla mas bu khyod su yin zhes pa gsum gyi lan du/

bdag skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po lags/ zhes pa gsum brjod pa dang*/ bla mas de ltar yin phan chad/ sems (90)nyid gdod ma nas skye ma myong ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du zhugs shig /ces brjod do// gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de nas slob mas thal mo sbyar te// kye kye bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// bdag la rab tu dgongs su gsol// bdag ni khams gsum 'khor gnas su// yun ring gnas pas dran nyams te// 'khor ba nyid las brgal don du// bla ma la yang zhu bar bgyid// bskal pa brgya phrag du mar ni// bdag ni yang nas yang 'khor bas// rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes rang byung nyid// rmed dang rtsa ba bcad pas sangs rgyas sems las byung*// sems kyi dam pa bdag la bstan du gsol// zhes pa gsum brjod do// sems nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan pa ni// de nas slob mas ma yengs par bla ma'i thugs kar car re bltas nas yengs pa'i mtshams su/ bla mas drag shul dang bcas pas/ sems gang yin zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ bar der had de sal le gzung 'dzin med pa'i shes pa rang bab cig phyam gyis shar ba ni chos sku'i dgongs pa ste ye shes dbab pa'o// dkyil 'khor gsum du zhugs pa'i dbang la gsum las/ sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i dbang ni/ slob ma rnams seng ge'i 'dug stangs dang bstun te/ mig thad drang du ha re ba glang chen lta stangs las/ rig pa 'od kyi gong bu skar mda' ltar shar phyogs su 'phangs te/ seng ge'i mchongs stabs su byas pa'i mthar/ chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang la bzhag pa'i rim pa rnams/ bla ma'i gsung gsal la snyan pas brjod pa'i rim pa bzhin yid gtod cig /ces dmigs pa phog pas/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing (91)khams zhes bya ba shin tu mdzes shing*/ nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong ba na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya ba/

sku mdog mthing ka rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis su med pa 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to// bu khyod der glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ltos la seng ge'i mchongs stangs kyis mchongs shig /a a āḥ zhes sku gsum las phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyas gdab bo// yang slob ma rnams lhor bltas la glang po che'i 'dug stangs dang bstun te/ mig thad drang du dril nas/ snga ma ltar rig pa dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing du 'phags te sked pa snyengs kyis mchongs pas slebs nas/ skye med du glod pa'i rim pa rnams tshig gi phyir sems gzhol du 'jug pa ni/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /lho phyogs na dpal dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams shin tu mdzes shing nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya ba/ sku mdog ser po rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis su med pa/ 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to// bu khyod der seng ge'i lta stangs kyis ltos la stag mo'i mchongs stangs kyis mchongs shig /a a āḥ zhes phyir (92)mi ldog pa'i rgyas gdab bo// yang nub tu kha bltas la drang srong gi 'dug stangs dang mig g.yon zur nas khad kyis thad drang du khrid la rig pa 'phangs la zhing khams su bya lding thabs kyis mchongs la/ tshig gis gsal gdab pa ni/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig

/nub phyogs na pad+ma brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams mdzes shing nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas zhes bya ba/ sku mdog dmar po rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis su med pa 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing*/ rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to// bu khyod dpal chen gyi rngams stabs kyis ltos la/ khyung nam mkha' la lding ba'i 'gros kyis songs shig /a a āḥ zhes phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyas gdab bo// yang byang du bltas te bya rgod kyi spungs stangs dang bstun la/ mig gyen du ldog nas zhing khams yid la byed pas/ lag pa'i khu tshur snying ga nas phyir 'phangs pa dang mchongs pa mnyam du bya ba'i tshul gyis/ tshig gi phyir sems gzhol ba snyam du gsal gdab pa ni/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /'di nas byang phyogs na las rab yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams shin tu mdzes shing nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ sku mdog ljang gu rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis su med pa/ 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs (93)rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing*/ rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to// bu khyod der rdo rje 'chang gi lta stangs kyi ltos la/ glog dmar gyi 'gyu stangs kyis songs shig /a a āḥ zhes rgyas gdab bo// de dag ni rang snang rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas 'jug pa ste/

tshe 'dir nyams su blang long ma byung ba/ rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du skyes nas grol ba'i dgos pa yod do// longs sku'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i dbang ni/ rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug la/ mig ha re ba las rgyan stug po bkod pa yid la byas par rig pa 'phangs nas/ seng ge ltar yud kyis mchongs te skye med kyi ngang la bzhag pa rnams rim par gsal gdab pa ni/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po nyon cig /de dag thams cad las 'das pa'i pha rol na/ rgyan yongs su bkod pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams na ye shes lngas khyad cing gsal ba/ rab tu mnyam zhing mi g.yo ba nyid na/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba/ 'khor yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brgya stong bye ba dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ sems nyid mngon par 'dus ma byas pa la rol pa zhig yod kyis/ bu khyod der glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ltos la seng ge'i mchongs stangs kyis songs shig /a a āḥ zhes sku gsum las mi ldog pa'i rgyas gdab bo// chos (94)sku'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i dbang ni/ seng ge'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ mig gyen dang thur dang 'phred g.yas g.yon dang thad drang du bltas te/ rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes la gsal stong 'dzin med chen por lta zhing*/ gsal gdab pa ni/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po nyon cig /de las kyang 'das pa'i pha rol na/ rang gi sems nyid pas mdo dang bral zhing tshad med dpag tu med cing dmigs su med pa/ stong nyid gang du'ang ma phye ba'i chos nyid ces bya ba bzhugs pas/ der bu khyod rig pa khyung nam mkha' la lding ba'i 'gros kyis mtho bar 'dug cig /drang srong gi 'dug stangs kyis gnas par gyis shig

/glang chen gyi nyal stabs kyis snyoms par nyol zhig /lcags sdong gi 'dril stabs kyis kha sbubs la mtha' dril cig /skyes bu'i rgyangs stabs kyis gan rgyal du rgyongs shig /wa mo'i zur 'gros kyis slog la songs shig /bya rgod kyi spungs stabs kyis sgur ldog gis spungs shig /gyad kyi dor stabs kyis ngal gsos las sa non cig /'bu srin gyi nur 'gros kyis dbyings rig la chags par gyis shig /stag mo'i mchongs stangs kyis nyams snang la rtsal sbyongs shig /g.yang ma'i sprugs stangs kyis gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags thams cad dus gcig la ngo bor sprugs shig /seng ge'i 'gying tshugs kyis dbyings rig las zungs shig /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /sems nyid stong par gnas pas gzhi zungs shig /sems nyid rig stong du bstan pas gnad tshugs shig /sems nyid ma 'gags par 'gyu bas rtsal sbyongs shig /sems nyid ye shes su gsal bas lam sbyongs shig /sems nyid (95)kun la khyab pas rtags tshol zhig /sems nyid cig char du myur bas la zlos shig /sems nyid sna tshogs su ma 'dres pas shan phyes shig /sems nyid sna tshogs su 'phel bas ma zhen cig /ye shes las slar ma ldog cig /thig le las slar ma ldog cig /sku las slar ma ldog cig /ces brjod nas/ de dag gi don cung zad bshad na/ sprul sku dang*/ longs sku'i 'char gzhi ni chos sku yin pas/ de gnyis las 'das pa zhes bya'o// zhing ni sems nyid ye nas stong pas na/ ston pa ni rang rig gi ye shes te/ 'dug stangs ngang gzigs stangs gcun nas nyams su blangs pas rang shar du rang ngo shes nas gzhi thog tu grol lo// de yang nyams kyi rim pa dang mthun par rig stong gi sems nyid ngo shes pas thag chod/ rang shar rang grol du rtsal sbyongs/ gsal stong dang dwangs su lhun gyis zhog /gang shar rjes med du nyams su longs/ rang grol ye babs su la zlos/

shar nas yengs med du ngos bzung*/ bde gsal rtog med kyi nyams la ma zhen cig /de ltar nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu sku gsum rang chas su 'char bar slas ma ldog cig /ces bshad do// don gsum pa dbang las thob pa'i ngo sprod ni/ sku gsum gyi bzhugs stangs dang gzigs stangs rim pas bstun du bcug la/ lan gsum du gsal bar brjod pa ni/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po// sems nyid ngo bor stong la rang bzhin ye shes lhag mthong gi don nyon cig /sems nyid bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i gzhi ye shes lngar sgyur cig /sems nyid stong pa ye shes zang thal gyis ma rig pa sol cig /sems nyid blo rim dang 'jug pa'i theg pa tha dad kyi mthar thig le nyag gcig (96)tu sdus shig /sems nyid stong pa mtha' bral thig le yongs rdzogs la chos kyi phugs gtod cig /sems nyid zung 'jug dbyer med rang snang lhug pas don gyi gnad khrol zhig /sems nyid dbyings rig rnam dag smin mtshams 'od gsal la rlung rig bcud la bor zhig /gang zhe na/ mgrin pa en tsam dgug /mig gyen la ldog /rlung rang sor bcad/ lag pa g.yas pas mig mnan la/ mig g.yon pa nam mkha' la bltas pas ye shes kyi snang ba 'phel lo// sems nyid chos sku ma bcos rang byung rnal ma la phyi nang gcig tu gzhi phong cig /sems nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs nyag gcig phyogs bral las slar ma ldog cig /sprul skur song zhig /longs skur song zhig /chos skur song zhig /chos sku la ma 'dzin slar ma ldog cig /longs sku la ma 'dzin slar ma ldog cig /sprul sku la ma 'dzin slar ma ldog cig /ces dang pos sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs dang gzigs stangs bstan nas/ bar la gzhan de dang 'dra ba las/ mgrin pa thad drang la bzhag /mig cung zad dbab ces go brje'o// tha mal de'i tshab tu mgrin pa bstod/ mig thad drang du blta/ zhes go brje'o// de dag gi don cung zad bshad na/

sems ni kun tu rtog pa 'khor ba'i sa bon la/ sems nyid ni ma 'khrul don gyi ye shes su ye nas gnas pa yin pas/ sems nyid ngo bo stong*/ rang bzhin gsal/ thugs rje'i gdangs 'gag med chen po'i gnas lugs nyag gcig ste ngo shes par gyis shig /de yang sngar thun mong gi theg pa a nu man chad kyi skabs su/ sems nyid rig stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por bzung ba de nyid/ a ti rdo rje snying po'i skabs 'dir rig pa 'od gsal lnga ldan du ngo shes par gyis shig /sems nyid stong gsal rig pa'i ye shes ka dag chen pos gnyis (97)'dzin 'khrul pa'i ma rig pa rang sangs la thongs shig /sngar theg pa rim pa dgu so sor zhen pa'i blo rim thams cad ye grol grub mtha' med pa'i ngang du shes par gyis shig /chos su shar ro cog mtha' 'bral thig le chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos par ngos zungs shig /rim pa gnyis med rang snang nyid zung 'jug ye shes chen por ngo shes par gyis shig /gnad kyis mthong ba'i dbyings rig 'od gsal smin mtshams su snang ba nas rim gyis brtson par gyis shig /de yang gzigs stangs dang*/ bzhugs stangs dang*/ rlung rig gi gnad bstun nas nyams su longs shig /sems nyid chos sku rang byung ni ka dag chos zad kyi dgongs pa'i ngang dwangs ma 'dres yongs rdzogs lhun grub kyi rang snang ste/ khregs chod dang thod rgal gnyis kyis nyams su longs shig /sku gsum gyi rang snang rim gyis shar ba'i ngang du song la snang ba dang rang rig pa'i nyams ci byung yang ma 'dzin par zad pa'i sa nas gdod ma'i dbyings su tshe 'di nyid la phyin par gyis shig /ces ngo sprad cing dal bus sos dal la bshad do// 'di dag ni mngon sum rig pa'i ngo sprod de/ rtsa ba dang phra tig las/ de nas ngo sprad par bya'o// zhes pa'i tshig tsam gsungs nas ngo sprad lugs ma gsungs pas gnad yig las byung ba bzhin bkod pa'o// de yang ngo sprod pa'i rim pa 'di nyid ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do// khrid du ngo sprad pa yin pa'i phyir ro// de'ang khrid mi byed pa'i dbang du byas na ngo sprad pa'o// don gsum pa dbugs dbyung zhing dga' ston bya ba'i rim pa la gnyis las/

dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dbang 'di thobs nas ma rig pa gzhi la sangs te rig pa ye shes su rgyas pas rang snang mngon sum bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ nyams su lan long ma byung yang*/ (98)rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du skyel/ 'byung ba'i goms shugs phal pa rnams bar dor grol zhing*/ mchog rnams tshe 'dir grol bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje la rang dbang thob pa yin no// zhes brjod do// dga' stan no// dbang gi rjes la bla ma dang*/ de'i nye 'khor na 'khod pa'i rdo rje spun sring rnams la tshogs kyis mchod cing yon dbul dgos te/ ma phul na dngos grub mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de skad du dbang rnam par phye ba las/ 'di ltar dbang bskur dus dag tu// dga' ston ma byas mi 'grub cing*// dngos grub dag kyang nyams par 'gyur// de bas tshogs kyi dga' ba bya// zhes so// byas na 'di dang phyi ma'i legs pa thams cad 'grub cing*/ nyes pa thams cad sel la/ bsam dgu thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub ste/ de nyid las/ bla ma dang ni bla ma'i 'khor// yum dang bcas pa thams cad la// dga' ston chen po sus byas pa// legs pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*// nyes pa kun las grol bar 'gyur// zhes so// de yang dbang gi dus su yo byad mchod pa dang*/ gzhan gyi dus su mchod pa gnyis bsod nams khyad che bar/ de nyid las/ gal te dbang bskur dus min par// rang gi bla ma mchod pa ni// brgya stong bye ba grangs med pas// dbang gi dus gcig byas pa yi// bsod nams tshad med dpag tu med// ces so// de'i dus su bla ma de la phyogs bcu'i bla ma dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dbyer mi phyed par 'dus nas/ ngo bo gcig pa'i dus khyad par can yin pa'i phyir ro// dbang dus kyi bud med gcig la byin pa dang*/ dus gzhan du ye shes kyi ma mo brgya'am rdo rje phag mo la tshogs dgu brgyas mchod pa gnyis bsod nams (99)'di che bar/

phra tig las/ ma mo brgya'am phag mo la// tshogs kyi mchod pa brgya phrag dgu// dus ma yin par byas pa bas// 'di dus rnal 'byor ma gcig la// bza' btung cung zad byin pa yi// bsod nams 'di ni mnyam pa yin// 'jig rten 'di la 'dod don dang*// phyi ma ye shes dbyings spyod phyir// mkha' spyod dag gi dngos grub ni// 'khor dang bcas pas 'grub pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de ltar rab tu spros med cho ga'i don// shin tu gsal bar deng sang phye ba yis// bsod nams 'od dkar ku mu tas mtshon pa// de yis 'gro kun byang chub thob par shog /rab dkar gangs ri'i drung na zla 'od ltar// ches dkar snying po'i gsal byed dam pa 'di// phyi rabs don du klong chen rab 'byams kyis// gangs ri thod dkar mgul du bkod pa yin// gsang ba snying tig gi dbang rnam par phye ba las/ rab tu spros pa med pa tshig dbang rin po che'i gsal byed/ 'od kyi dra ba zhes bya ba rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/// /dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /(100)000
